## 🌟 Summary
**Ultralytics 8.4.207 restores reliable PaddlePaddle export and inference, while refreshing several Docker base images.**

## 📊 Key Changes
- 🐛 **Fixed PaddlePaddle setup:** Adds the missing `six` dependency required by `x2paddle`, which could break exports in fresh environments.
- 🎮 **Improved Paddle GPU handling:** A shared setup check now recognizes installed GPU builds and avoids replacing them with CPU builds. Export, inference, and PaddleOCR use this check.
- ✅ **Re-enabled Paddle export testing:** CI now tests both exporting a model to Paddle format and running inference with the exported model.
- 🐳 **Updated Docker images:** The AMD GPU image moves to Ubuntu 26.04 and Python 3.14; the NVIDIA ARM64 image updates to NVIDIA PyTorch 26.10, CUDA 13.4, and TensorRT 11.4. Other images use refreshed floating Debian tags.
- 📘 **Clarified platform guidance:** Documentation explains PaddlePaddle installation requirements and reiterates that TensorRT 11 does not support JetPack; Jetson TensorRT workflows should use a compatible TensorRT 10.x runtime.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- 🚀 Paddle exports and inference should work more consistently on fresh installations, and automated testing is back to catch regressions.
- 🛡️ Users with Paddle GPU installations are less likely to have them accidentally replaced during setup.
- 🔧 Updated Docker bases provide newer operating-system and NVIDIA software releases. These updates do **not** introduce model architecture changes.

## What's Changed
* Move Docker base images to the newest Ubuntu, NGC and floating Debian tags by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27085
* `ultralytics 8.4.207` Fix PaddlePaddle export on new installs and CUDA machines by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27088


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/compare/v8.4.206...v8.4.207

summary:
## 🌟 Summary
**Ultralytics 8.4.206 improves PaddleOCR’s handling of upside-down text and makes OCR/rotated-box labels easier to read.** 🔄

## 📊 Key Changes
- **Reads upside-down text with PaddleOCR:** The OCR solution now uses a text-line orientation classifier to identify text that may be upside down. It tries those crops in both orientations and keeps the reading with higher confidence. This also helps with bottom-to-top text when its crop is oriented upside down.
- **Updates OCR dependencies:** PaddleOCR now requires `paddleocr>=3.7` and PaddlePaddle 3.1 or later. Custom recognizers are unchanged and do not get automatic orientation correction.
- **Improves label placement:** OCR and oriented bounding-box labels now sit above the top-left of the box enclosing the polygon, rather than covering rotated text or appearing at an arbitrary corner. OCR labels also use black text on green for contrast.
- **Refreshes CI runner labels:** GitHub Actions now uses `macos-latest` and `ubuntu-26.04-arm` labels, reducing future maintenance as runner images change.
- **Clarifies NXP documentation:** The guide describes NXP’s Neutron SDK source as a pip package index instead of linking to a page that returns an error in browsers. Export behavior is unchanged.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- **More reliable OCR:** PaddleOCR users should get better results on text that appears upside down, with the more confident reading selected automatically.
- **Clearer visualizations:** Labels are less likely to obscure text or polygons, making plotted results easier to inspect.
- **No change for custom OCR backends:** Users supplying their own recognizer remain responsible for handling text orientation.
- **No change to NXP exports:** The documentation link was corrected; pip-based SDK installation continues to work.

## What's Changed
* Use macos-latest and ubuntu-26.04-arm runner labels by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27080
* Place OCR and OBB labels above the box instead of over rotated text by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27081
* Drop the NXP package index link that only answers pip by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27082
* `ultralytics 8.4.206` Read upside-down and bottom-to-top text in OCR by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27083


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/compare/v8.4.205...v8.4.206

summary:
## 🌟 Summary
Release **8.4.205** adds a ready-to-use scene-text OCR solution, led by YOLO26-Text detection paired with PaddleOCR or a custom recognizer, alongside important tiled-inference and export fixes.

## 📊 Key Changes
- 📝 **New OCR solution:** Detects text with detection, OBB, or segmentation models, then recognizes it with optional PaddleOCR or a custom callable. Results include recognized text, confidence scores, original-image polygons, detection indices, and reading-order sorting. The core `Results` API remains unchanged.
- 🔤 **YOLO26-Text resources:** Adds guidance for the YOLO26-Text checkpoint family and a new OBB training dataset combining COCO-Text and HierText, with **65,325 images and about 1.29 million word polygons**.
- 🧩 **More reliable tiled inference:** Removes covered seam fragments, handles empty tiled predictions on Apple MPS, and fixes related segmentation, validation-memory, and class-count issues.
- 📦 **More dependable exports:** LiteRT and NXP exports now run on CPU to avoid failures on MPS and incorrect results on CUDA. DEEPX support is updated for DX-COM 2.5.0 and its matching runtime requirements.
- 📱 **Expanded deployment guidance:** Adds a MediaTek Dimensity Android guide and improves documentation for high-resolution tiling and DEEPX deployment.
- ✅ **Small correctness fixes:** `yolo checks` now ignores requirements that do not apply to the current environment, and dataset split fractions reject booleans instead of treating them as numbers.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- OCR users can build a text-reading workflow from detection through recognition without writing their own crop, ordering, and result-handling pipeline. PaddleOCR remains optional; custom recognizers can be plugged in.
- The new scene-text dataset makes it easier to train word detectors for signs, documents, receipts, and other real-world text. It provides detection annotations, not transcripts for recognition training.
- Tiled predictions should contain fewer duplicate or incomplete boxes at window seams, while fixes improve reliability for tiled segmentation and validation.
- CPU-based LiteRT and NXP export avoids device-specific export problems; DEEPX users should match DX-COM 2.5.0 models with **DX-RT 3.5.0 or newer**.
- The MediaTek guide clarifies that released Android support covers CPU and GPU inference; its NPU results use a prototype and are not yet supported by the released plugin.

## What's Changed
* Add hero, FAQ, and SEO metadata to the High Resolution Tiling guide by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27070
* Add Open in Colab badge to the High Resolution Tiling guide by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27071
* Fix tiled segmentation boxes, mask thresholds, val memory, and class counts by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27073
* Drop seam fragments and fix empty MPS tiles in tiled merges by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27072
* Refresh the tiling guide hero after the seam fix and add the enlarge tip by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27074
* Fix LiteRT and NXP exports that fail on MPS or give wrong outputs on CUDA by @amanharshx in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27075
* Add MediaTek integration documentation for validated LiteRT deployment by @UltralyticsAssistant in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27079
* Skip requirements whose environment markers do not apply in `yolo checks` by @MohammadHijjawi97 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27078
* Reject boolean split fraction values by @nethmitharushika56 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27068
* Update DEEPX export to DX-COM 2.5.0 and DX-RT 3.5.0 runtime docs by @deepx-dgkim in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27077
* Add Scene Text OBB dataset by @Laughing-q in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27076
* `ultralytics 8.4.205` Add scene text OCR solution with YOLO26-Text and PaddleOCR by @Laughing-q in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27061

## New Contributors
* @nethmitharushika56 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27068

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/compare/v8.4.204...v8.4.205
